# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 53 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 53 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_053_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 4 — Summer Comes: The Age to Come Reveals Everything

**53:1** He showed me many trees — some were budding with new leaves and others were dried out. He said to me: "What do you see in these trees?" "Lord," I said, "some are budding and some are dried out." "The ones that are budding," he said, "represent the righteous who will live in the age to come. The age to come is summer for the righteous — but winter for the sinners.

**53:2** When God's mercy finally shines out on everything, those who serve God will be revealed for who they are — all people will be revealed. Just as in summer every tree's fruit appears and everyone can see what each tree really is — so the fruit of the righteous will appear, and everyone who has been flourishing in the coming age will be recognized.

**53:3** But the Gentiles and sinners — think back to those dried-out trees you saw — that's what they'll be like: dried out, without any fruit, in the age to come. They'll be burned as firewood and exposed for what they were, because the way they lived was evil. Sinners will be burned because they sinned and never repented. Gentiles will be burned because they never acknowledged the One who made them.

**53:4** So produce fruit. Make sure you have something to show in that coming summer. Don't get buried in business affairs or tangled up in accumulating wealth of every kind. Practice holiness instead, so that you're ready when summer comes and you aren't found dried out. Everyone absorbed in business and wealth will be found dried out in that age — unless they're bearing fruit."

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, capturing the urgent eschatological warning of Similitude 4.*
